_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to credentials.json in this directory and fill in the keys.
credentials.json is gitignored and must never be committed. The Angle C
collection harness reads it and prints, before any paid call, which provider
and which account_hint each route will bill.
Either paste a key into api_key, or leave api_key empty and set api_key_env
to the name of an environment variable holding it. If both are present the
environment variable wins, so a shell export can override the file without

together.account_hint: which Together account this bills (free text, printed at pre-flight)

deepinfra.account_hint: which DeepInfra account this bills (free text, printed at pre-flight)
